title: From Genetic Risk to Spatial Brain Vulnerability

analysis.gwas_title: Multi-ancestry genome-wide association meta-analysis of Parkinson's disease
analysis.null_model: Euclidean nearest neighbors after unit-variance standardization
analysis.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across 138 regions separately for each gene-set version
analysis.null_summary_note: Per-region random mean and standard deviation are retained; individual permutation draws were not exported by Stage 6.

spatial_sensitivity.neighbor_definition: 26-connectivity: voxel face, edge, or corner contact
spatial_sensitivity.global_statistic: maximum standardized positive regional Stage 6 Z-score
spatial_sensitivity.robust_rule: positive Stage 6 Z AND Stage 6 FDR < 0.05 AND Stage 7 spatial-null FDR < 0.05

independent_validation.phenotype: Sign-reversed Cohen's d for cortical thickness or subcortical volume; higher means thinner/smaller in PD
independent_validation.independence_note: Independent measurement and analysis; exact participant-disjointness from the upstream GWAS cannot be guaranteed
independent_validation.substantia_nigra: Not measured in the public ENIGMA-PD FreeSurfer tables

biological_interpretation.status: post-hoc interpretation of frozen discovery outputs
biological_interpretation.background: 15,632 genes retained in the Stage 2 AHBA matrix
biological_interpretation.region_rule: top 10 by frozen Stage 7 robustness rank
biological_interpretation.interpretation_note: Enrichment and cell-type associations do not establish causality, pathology, pathway activation, or clinical utility

validation_score.label: Independent validation
validation_score.scale: diverging, symmetric about zero; gray is not measured

agreement.label: Agreement
agreement.scale: four pre-specified median-split categories; gray is not measured

atlas.name: Automated Anatomical Labeling atlas 3 (AAL3v1)
atlas.mapping: region_id equals the nonzero integer voxel label in AAL3v1.nii.gz
atlas.geometry_method: Exposed voxel faces extracted from retained labels and greedily merged only when coplanar and contiguous
atlas.render_coordinate_mapping: MNI (x, y, z) is rendered as WebGL (x, z, y) so superior is up

sources.name: Human Protein Atlas v25.1 single-nucleus brain
